entry.content:
• (Google Cloud CLI) Removed the legacy Cloud SQL Proxy V1 component ('cloud_sql_proxy') from the Google Cloud CLI. All connect commands now rely exclusively on Cloud SQL Auth Proxy V2 ('cloud-sql-proxy').
  • (API Registry) Removed gcloud api-registry mcp servers list and gcloud api-registry mcp tools list. For similar functionality, see Agent Registry at <https://docs.cloud.google.com/sdk/gcloud/reference/alpha/agent-registry/mcp-servers>.
  • (Cloud Services) Removed gcloud beta services mcp policies get, gcloud beta services mcp policies get-effective, and gcloud beta services mcp policies test-enabled as MCP policies are not required and they have been functioning as no-ops.
entry.summary: Several legacy components and commands have been removed from the gcloud CLI, including the Cloud SQL Proxy V1 component and specific API Registry and Cloud Services commands. Users should refer to updated documentation for alternative functionalities.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: CLI components removed

entry.content: • Updated anthos-cli with newer go version and library dependencies.
entry.summary: The Anthos command-line interface has been updated with newer Go versions and library dependencies. This update ensures improved performance and security for the Anthos platform.
entry.title: Anthos: Anthos CLI Update

entry.content:
• Updated the Java SDK to version 5.1.0 build from the open source project https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/appengine-java-standard/releases/tag/v5.1.0.
  • Upgraded Jetty 12.0 to 12.0.38 and Jetty 12.1 to 12.1.12.
  • Added gRPC support to the App Engine Images service for image transformations and composition.
entry.summary: The App Engine Java SDK has been updated to version 5.1.0, incorporating upgrades to Jetty and adding gRPC support to the Images service for enhanced image transformations.
entry.title: App Engine: App Engine Java SDK Update

entry.content: • Added --flags flag to gcloud beta app-lifecycle-manager flags releases create to allow creating flag releases from a list of flag IDs.
entry.summary: You can now create flag releases using a list of flag IDs. This is done by using the new `--flags` flag with the `gcloud beta app-lifecycle-manager flags releases create` command.
entry.title: App Lifecycle Manager: App Lifecycle Manager flags release creation

entry.content: • Enabled Airflow CLI commands for Composer environments running new Airflow 3.3.x versions.
entry.summary: You can now run Airflow CLI commands for Composer environments. This is available for environments running Airflow 3.3.x versions. This enhancement provides greater flexibility and control over your workflows.
entry.title: Cloud Composer: Airflow CLI now available for Composer

entry.content: • Added support for search shorthands to gcloud beta firestore indexes composite create.
entry.summary: Enhance your Firestore database with new shorthand options for creating composite indexes using `gcloud beta firestore indexes composite create`. This update simplifies index management and improves query performance.
entry.title: Cloud Firestore: New Firestore Indexing Features

entry.content: • Added --protection-level and --crypto-key-backend flags to gcloud kms keys versions update command.
entry.summary: The Cloud Key Management Service now supports updating key versions with new protection levels and crypto key backends via the `gcloud kms keys versions update` command. This provides greater flexibility in managing cryptographic keys.
entry.title: Cloud Key Management Service: KMS Key Version Update Enhancements

entry.summary: We are pleased to announce that the 'broker-disk' flags for Managed Kafka have reached General Availability (GA). This release enhances control over broker disk configurations, providing more flexibility for your Kafka deployments.
entry.title: Cloud Managed Kafka: Managed Kafka Broker Disk Flags Now Generally Available

entry.content:
• Promote gcloud run instances commands to the beta track.
  • Added --delay-execution flag to gcloud beta run jobs command groups to allow run job execution within a delay window.
  • Added --run-upload flag to gcloud beta run deploy to specify that the source should be uploaded via the Cloud Run UploadSource API.
entry.summary: The `gcloud run instances` commands are now in beta. You can also now delay the execution of Cloud Run jobs using the `--delay-execution` flag and specify source uploads via the Cloud Run UploadSource API with the `--run-upload` flag.
entry.title: Cloud Run: Cloud Run updates: Instance commands and job execution

entry.content: • Updated 'cloud-sql-proxy' packaged component to use 2.25.2 of the Cloud SQL Proxy.
entry.summary: The Cloud SQL Proxy has been updated to version 2.25.2. This update ensures improved performance and security for your database connections.
entry.title: Cloud SQL: Cloud SQL Proxy Updated

entry.content: • Added --remote_functions_host_port flag to Spanner emulator start command. This flag allows Spanner emulator to connect to a Functions Framework instance that hosts implementation of Remote User Defined Functions.
entry.summary: The Spanner emulator now supports connecting to a Functions Framework instance for remote user-defined functions. This is enabled by the new --remote_functions_host_port flag, allowing for more flexible function implementations.
entry.title: Cloud Spanner Emulator: Spanner emulator supports remote functions

entry.content: • Changed the default value of --pool-size flag for gcloud workstations configs create and gcloud beta workstations configs create to 1. To explicitly create a configuration without a fast start pool, run with --pool-size=0.
entry.summary: The default value for the `--pool-size` flag in `gcloud workstations configs create` and `gcloud beta workstations configs create` has been updated to 1. To disable the fast start pool, set `--pool-size=0`.
entry.title: Cloud Workstations: Cloud Workstations default pool size changed

entry.content:
• Added gcloud compute composite-health-checks test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine composite health check in alpha, beta, and GA.
  • Added --security-settings-client-tls-policy, --security-settings-subject-alt-names, and --security-settings-aws-v4-* flags to gcloud compute backend-services create and update commands.
  • Added allowed value asn to flags --enforce-on-key and --enforce-on-key-configs to gcloud compute security-policies rules create and update commands in alpha, beta, and GA.
  • Added gcloud beta compute service-attachments test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a service attachment.
  • Added --consistent-hash-http-header-name flag to gcloud compute backend-services create and update commands.
  • Added BMSAI support to --confidential-compute-type option in gcloud compute instances create and bulk create commands.
  • Promoted identity support for Backend Services to GA.
entry.summary: New commands and flags are available for managing Compute Engine resources, including IAM permission testing, security settings, and network policies. Updates also include enhanced backend service identity support and confidential computing options.
entry.title: Compute Engine: Compute Engine Updates

entry.content:
• Added gcloud design-center spaces application-templates export command to export IaC for an application template.
  • Added gcloud design-center spaces application-templates revisions export command to export IaC for an application template revision.
entry.summary: You can now export Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for application templates and their revisions using new gcloud design-center commands. This allows for easier management and version control of your application template configurations.
entry.title: Design Center: Export application templates

entry.summary: We are excited to announce that the `gcloud developer-connect account-connectors` commands have been promoted to General Availability. This release signifies a major step forward in simplifying your cloud development workflows.
entry.title: Developer Connect: Account Connectors Now Generally Available

entry.content: • Added gcloud beta orchestration-pipelines command group to manage Orchestration Pipelines.
entry.summary: A new command group, `gcloud beta orchestration-pipelines`, has been added to manage Orchestration Pipelines. This simplifies the process of controlling and deploying your pipeline workflows.
entry.title: Orchestration Pipelines: Manage Orchestration Pipelines

entry.content:
• Added gcloud vmware private-clouds migrate-management-vms which migrates the management VMs of a private cloud from the current management cluster to a workload cluster.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: You can now migrate VMware Engine management VMs from the current management cluster to a workload cluster using the `gcloud vmware private-clouds migrate-management-vms` command. This feature enhances flexibility in managing your private cloud infrastructure.
entry.title: Vmware Engine: Migrate VMware Engine management VMs
